nodes.label: QUESTIONS.md — Unattended Ambiguity Log
nodes.rationale: One entry per ambiguity recording file, decision faced, options, choice and why, always implemented as the most conservative interpretation, so an unattended run leaves an auditable and resumable trail instead of silent guesses.

nodes.label: A3 · min-duration guard vs. predicate stop
nodes.rationale: Applied the min-duration swallow guard uniformly to manual and predicate-triggered stops: most conservative, never produces a trial shorter than min_trial_duration_s, and inert today because KeypressStopCondition never self-triggers.

nodes.label: A3 · no distinct auto_flag for predicate stops
nodes.rationale: Inventing an auto_flag vocabulary entry before any real predicate exists risks the analysis QC gate being built against a code that will not match what a real pose-driven condition needs to express. auto_flags is already an open string set, so adding one later is one line, not a schema change.

nodes.label: A10 · read-only nodes misdiagnosed as camera fault (CORRECTED)
nodes.rationale: A9.5 recorded the RO nodes as a possible firmware fault, reasoning from DeviceAccessStatus, StreamIsGrabbing and TLParamsLocked — all host-side state for the probing process, none able to observe another process holding the camera. Actual cause was a live Spinnaker session. Cost: one round of misdirected hardware troubleshooting, no code rework.

nodes.label: A9.5 · UserSet verification list resolved by measurement
nodes.rationale: Probing showed the camera boots into factory Default with ExposureAuto/GainAuto Continuous, GammaEnable True at 0.80 and AcquisitionFrameRateEnable False — exactly the settings whose drift corrupts DLC training data, so those became the verification list. Lives in config.toml [camera_verify] rather than code constants so a second rig can differ without a source change.

nodes.label: A9.5 · chunk-data enablement vs. invariant 7
nodes.rationale: Chose to have the app enable chunk data idempotently at open() and amended invariant 7 explicitly rather than leaving code quietly contradicting the document. The stricter alternative (require it in UserSet1, hard-fail preflight) fails closed on a setting nobody would think to check, and its failure mode — a session blocked at the rig with an animal in hand — is worse.

nodes.label: A9.5 · camera settings not recorded in session metadata
nodes.rationale: Left shared/schema/ untouched rather than extending CameraInfo with measured values, because any field change is a schema_version bump requiring a coordinated two-repo commit — widening the blast radius past what this acquisition-local pass was scoped to. The change is additive when it happens and worth doing deliberately alongside the analysis repo.

nodes.label: A9.5 · encoder quality scales were shared (RESOLVED)
nodes.rationale: One crf key fed both codecs while -crf and -global_quality are different scales, so recorded quality silently depended on which encoder resolved on that machine — files from a QSV machine and an x264 machine were not comparable when pooled into one DLC training set. Split into crf and qsv_global_quality with per-codec preset; qsv_global_quality falls back to crf so older configs still load.

nodes.label: A9.5 · Mono8 vs colour pixel format
nodes.rationale: Chose Mono8 on a colour sensor: DLC gains nothing from colour for this task, Mono8 is a third of the bytes on a disk-constrained machine, and debayering costs host CPU on a PC with no usable GPU. Recorded honestly that Mono8 here is luma from the Bayer mosaic, so slightly softer than a true mono sensor. Flagged as a scientific call rather than silently settled.

nodes.label: B1 · stage 2 calibration has no checkpoint
nodes.rationale: Building an unassigned stage is scope expansion the overnight prompt explicitly warns against, and checkerboard calibration needs real images — there is no synthetic-data path the way B4's kinematics core has one, so it would not be unattended-buildable even if in scope. CalibrationRecord defines the data shape so B4 and a future calibration stage share one contract.

nodes.label: B3 · qc.nominal_fps as its own config key
nodes.rationale: Reusing analysis.fps would couple two concepts invariant 12 says must stay decoupled: setting analysis.fps to downsample kinematics would make every trial fail QC for fps deviation even though nothing about the capture changed. Added qc.nominal_fps (default 30.0, matching acquisition's capture.fps).

nodes.label: B5 · report stage cannot group by animal
nodes.rationale: Parsing trial_uid back into fields is fragile in general, not just at the edges — animal_id, project_name and initials are free-ish text that can themselves contain underscores. Built aggregate_overall() and aggregate_by_keypoint() against exactly the declared inputs; the clean later fix is adding animal_id/project_name columns to TrialSummaryRow, an additive change.

nodes.label: B6 · kinematics CLI stage not wired
nodes.rationale: Fabricating a DLC-shaped .h5 would mean inventing stage 7's output contract under time pressure purely to unblock stage 8's CLI wiring — speculative plumbing built to satisfy a checkpoint rather than a requirement. Registered kinematics as present-but-unimplemented; wiring it into STAGE_REGISTRY later is one additive Stage(...) entry.
